summary_1line: Ravana travels to the solar realm to challenge the Sun, but after a brief exchange through messengers he declares victory and departs.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana in the flying Pushpaka chariot arrives before the radiant Sun-god blazing with a thousand rays on the summit of Mount Sumeru.
The golden Sun-god adorned with crimson lotus garlands and jeweled halo stands while the demon envoy shields his eyes from the overwhelming light.
Ravana beats victory drums beside the Pushpaka chariot after proclaiming triumph before the blazing solar court.
